title: ranunculus leveilleanus
intro: Ranunculus leveilleanus, commonly known as the Sea Cakile or Sea Rocket, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Ranunculus leveilleanus include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
